newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-OAK HILL TO HOST 2003 PGA CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-OAK HILL TO HOST 2003 PGA CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: Oak Hill Country Club in Rochester, New York, was named to host the 85th PGA Championship in 2003, the PGA of America announced on Monday.
The Donald Ross-designed Oak Hill, founded in 1901, has hosted many memorable events including three U.S. Opens, the 1980 PGA Championship and last year's Ryder Cup matches.
Mark Brooks will look to defend his PGA Championship won at Valhalla Golf Club when the event takes place at Winged Foot Golf Club in Mamaroneck, New York, in 1997.
